
SHOW-FOUNDATION
Display contents of foundation.json

USAGE
  fspec show-foundation [section] [options]

ARGUMENTS
  [section] (optional)
    Specific section to show (optional)

OPTIONS
  --list-sections
    List section names only (without content)
  --line-numbers
    Show line numbers in output
  --draft
    Read from foundation.json.draft instead of foundation.json
  --final
    DISC-003: force the finalized foundation.json even when a draft exists

EXAMPLES
  1. Show all foundation data
  $ fspec show-foundation
  {
  "projectName": "fspec",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "sections": {...}
}

  2. List available sections
  $ fspec show-foundation --list-sections
  Available sections:
  - Architecture Diagrams
  - System Overview
  - Project Goals

  3. Show specific section
  $ fspec show-foundation "Architecture Diagrams"
  {
  "Architecture Diagrams": [
    {...}
  ]
}

  4. Show section with line numbers
  $ fspec show-foundation "System Overview" --line-numbers
  1: {
2:   "System Overview": {
3:     ...
4:   }
5: }

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec update-foundation
  fspec add-diagram
  fspec validate-foundation-schema

NOTES
  • foundation.json is the machine-readable source of truth
  • Use generate-foundation-md for human-readable output
  • --list-sections helps discover available section names
  • --line-numbers useful for debugging or referencing specific lines
